datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Yemen in 2018. Geographic boundaries were delineated for different food insecurity phases and scenarios, with collection dates and classification scales recorded for each spatial unit. Data was compiled into GeoJSON and KML formats for three time periods (February, June, December 2018).
